Contract ManageBookCRUDService::createBook(callno: String,title: String,edition: String,author: String,publisher: String,description: String,isbn: String,copynum: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		obs: Set(Book) = Book.allInstance()->select(o|o.CallNo = callno)
	precondition:
		obs.isEmpty() = true
	postcondition:
		let ob: Book in
		(ob.oclIsNew() and
		Book.allInstance()->includes(ob) and
		ob.CallNo = callno and
		ob.Title = title and
		ob.Edition = edition and
		ob.Author = author and
		ob.Publisher = publisher and
		ob.Description = description and
		ob.ISBn = isbn and
		ob.CopyNum = copynum and
		result = true)
}
